'''Dolomite''' was a type of common [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]]. The statue of [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]], the eccentric [[Human/Legends|Human]] explorer and entrepreneur who founded [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] was made entirely of dolomite.
